_doc: Layer catalog. Values are exactly the CSV vocabulary, so the audience model can score any manifest built from them. Each value carries what the renderer needs (visual prompt fragments, style, audio preset) and EN/ZH localization. Edit descriptors freely; never rename values without refitting the audience model.

tagline.zh: 招募伙伴 · 并肩冒险

brand.tone: Warm and a little dramatic. No gore, no blood, no injuries, no sexual content, modest outfits. Every ad ends on an install call to action.
brand.art_style: Vertical 9:16 cinematic fantasy game key art, painterly premium mobile RPG style, rich lighting, clean silhouette, darker space at the top and bottom for text. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no blood.

cozy_cafe.visual: a cozy fantasy tavern-café interior at dusk: warm lantern light, wooden beams, steaming mugs on the counter, rain streaking the window

moonlit_temple.visual: ancient moonlit temple ruins at night: broken stone arches, glowing cyan runes carved in the pillars, a full moon, drifting mist

neon_city.visual: a rain-slick fantasy city street at night lit by glowing magenta and cyan arcane signs (shapes only, no readable letters), floating lanterns, reflections on wet cobblestones

storm_battlefield.visual: a storm-lashed battlefield on a high ridge: dark thunderclouds, forks of lightning, torn banners snapping in the wind, a distant army silhouette (no gore, no bodies)

sunlit_meadow.visual: a bright sunlit meadow of wildflowers with rolling hills and a distant white castle, soft clouds, golden-hour light

throne_room.visual: a grand throne room: tall stained-glass windows, golden light beams, a long red carpet, marble pillars, an ornate empty throne

Luna.visual: Luna, a young woman rogue with long silver hair under a dark hood, a charcoal-and-violet hooded cloak over fitted leather armor, a short blade whose edge glows with cyan runes, calm eyes and a faint dry half-smile

Rex.visual: Rex, a broad-shouldered young knight in heavy polished steel plate armor, a tall red plume on his helmet with the visor up, a red cape, a big confident grin
Rex.voice: loud, loyal, first into every fight

Mira.visual: Mira, a young woman healer in flowing white and gold robes, freckles across her nose, wavy auburn hair with a thin gold circlet, a warm smile, holding a slender staff that glows softly gold
Mira.voice: warm, attentive, remembers everything you tell her

Kael.visual: Kael, a lean young dark mage in black hooded robes with silver embroidery, short black hair, sharp features, a wry sardonic smirk, violet magic flickering around his fingers

casts_spell.visual: {name} casts a spell toward the viewer, both hands raised, a swirling burst of {magic} and glowing rune circles filling the air

close_up_smile.visual: a close-up portrait of {name} looking straight at the viewer with a warm, inviting smile, soft rim light on the face

draws_blade.visual: {name} draws a gleaming weapon in one fluid motion, {magic} flaring along the edge, wind lifting hair and cloth, determined but friendly expression toward the viewer

opens_treasure.visual: {name} opens an ornate treasure chest, golden light and sparkling gems spilling out and lighting the face with wonder

waves_to_camera.visual: {name} turns to the viewer and waves in a friendly greeting, as if inviting the viewer to join the party
